name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Surskit
flavour_text: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
flavour_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Maractus
flavour_text: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Karrablast
flavour_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Grubbin
flavour_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Fomantis
flavour_text: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

name: Lurantis
flavour_text: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Bounsweet
flavour_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavour_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Wimpod
flavour_text: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavour_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Fletchinder
flavour_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavour_text: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Turtonator
flavour_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavour_text: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that’s as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavour_text: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Primarina
flavour_text: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

name: Wishiwashi
flavour_text: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.

name: Dewpider
flavour_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavour_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pyukumuku
flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Bruxish
flavour_text: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Tapu Fini
flavour_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavour_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavour_text: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the “fireworks of the earth.”

name: Alolan Golem
flavour_text: It’s grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavour_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavour_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Tapu Koko
flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Spoink
flavour_text: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavour_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavour_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

name: Shuppet
flavour_text: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavour_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

name: Cutiefly
flavour_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Ribombee
flavour_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Comfey
flavour_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Tapu Lele
flavour_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog
flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
flavour_text: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

name: Necrozma
flavour_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Solrock
flavour_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Timburr
flavour_text: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
flavour_text: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Conkeldurr
flavour_text: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Mudbray
flavour_text: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale
flavour_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Minior
flavour_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavour_text: It shows no interest in anything that isn’t fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavour_text: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can’t possibly eat it all.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian
flavour_text: The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola’s waste-disposal site. They’re all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Mareanie
flavour_text: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

name: Toxapex
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavour_text: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on their heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

name: Escavalier
flavour_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki
flavour_text: Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

name: Magearna
flavour_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Jangmo-o
flavour_text: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
flavour_text: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Kommo-o
flavour_text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tauros
flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Fletchling
flavour_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Pikipek
flavour_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Trumbeak
flavour_text: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Toucannon
flavour_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Yungoos
flavour_text: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavour_text: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavour_text: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Komala
flavour_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavour_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.
